description: This Java source file defines the ModuleResourceRepository class, which manages Android resource repositories for a specific module within the Android Studio IDE. It includes methods for creating, updating, and retrieving resource repositories, as well as handling resource folder changes.

classes.name: ModuleResourceRepository
classes.description: Manages resource repositories for a specific Android module, supporting resource folder updates and creation.

classes.name: EmptyRepository
classes.description: A placeholder resource repository with no resources, used when no resource folder is available.

methods.name: getModuleResources
methods.description: Retrieves the resource repository for a given module or AndroidFacet, optionally creating it if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ModuleResourceRepository for a given AndroidFacet, handling both Gradle and non-Gradle projects.

methods.name: updateRoots
methods.description: Updates the resource folder roots based on current resource directories.

methods.name: updateRoots(List<VirtualFile>)
methods.description: Internal method to refresh resource folder repositories based on a list of resource directories.

methods.name: createForTest
methods.description: Creates a test instance of ModuleResourceRepository with specified resource roots.
